title: Digitization of Analogue Gauges using Computer Vision
abstract: arXiv:2611.26262v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Analogue gauges remain prevalent in manufacturing industries for measuring physical quantities, yet manual monitoring by operators introduces human error and operational inefficiency. This research developed and evaluated an automated gauge reading system using computer vision and deep learning techniques. Three hybrid approaches were implemented and compared: OpenCV with Scikit-Image (traditional computer vision), OpenCV with ResNet18, and OpenCV with VGG19 (deep learning approaches). A comprehensive dataset of 1,848 pressure gauge images (0-10 BAR range) was curated through web scraping, synthetic generation, and augmentation techniques. The experimental results demonstrate that ResNet18 significantly outperforms the alternatives, achieving an accuracy of 97.3%, compared to VGG19's 64.4% and Scikit-Image's 63.8%. translated_title: 基于计算机视觉的模拟仪表数字化
translated_abstract: 模拟仪表在制造业中仍被广泛用于测量物理量，然而操作员的手动监控会引入人为误差并降低运营效率。本研究开发并评估了一种基于计算机视觉和深度学习技术的自动化仪表读数系统。研究实现并比较了三种混合方法：OpenCV结合Scikit-Image（传统计算机视觉）、OpenCV结合ResNet18以及OpenCV结合VGG19（深度学习方法）。通过网络爬取、合成生成和数据增强技术，研究团队整理了一个包含1,848张压力表图像（0-10 BAR量程）的综合数据集。实验结果表明，ResNet18显著优于其他方法，准确率达到97.3%，而VGG19为64.4%，Scikit-Image为63.8%。该研究验证了残差学习架构在工业仪表数字化中的有效性，并提供了一个稳健的（文本在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究开发了基于计算机视觉的自动化仪表读数系统，通过对比三种混合方法证明OpenCV结合ResNet18的方案准确率最高（97.3%），验证了残差学习架构在工业模拟仪表数字化中的有效性。
en_tdlr: This study develops an automated gauge reading system using computer vision, demonstrating that OpenCV combined with ResNet18 achieves 97.3% accuracy and significantly outperforms VGG19 and traditional methods, validating the effectiveness of residual learning architectures for industrial analogue gauge digitization.
